name: Require TLS for S3 bucket requests
description: Require all requests to an S3 bucket and its objects to use secure transport.

remediation.summary: Add an S3 bucket policy that denies requests when secure transport is not used.
remediation.rationale: Requiring TLS protects data in transit between clients and Amazon S3.

potential_side_effects: Clients or applications using unencrypted HTTP requests will be denied access.
Applications must use HTTPS endpoints to access the bucket.
preconditions: Confirm the target bucket identity and AWS account.
Confirm the bucket is managed by Terraform.
Inspect the existing bucket policy for compatibility.
Review the Terraform plan before applying changes.

validation.method: Inspect the live bucket policy and verify the explicit deny for requests where aws:SecureTransport is false.
success_criteria: The bucket policy contains a Deny statement for insecure transport.
The Deny statement covers both the bucket ARN and bucket objects.
HTTPS requests are not denied by this statement.
Security Hub control S3.5 reports PASSED after reassessment.

rollback.strategy: Restore the previously approved bucket policy through Terraform.
rollback.warning: Do not remove existing bucket-policy protections as part of rollback without explicit review and approval.
